lines.zh: 牙齿先动，脚步才跟上来。
lines.en: My teeth move first; my feet follow after.

lines.zh: 四只一起挪，巢穴留在背后。
lines.en: Four of us shuffle on, the nest left behind.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边啃路边的石头。
lines.en: I gnaw the roadside stones as I walk.

lines.zh: 诅咒推着我，一步一步往前。
lines.en: The curse pushes me forward, step by step.

lines.zh: 巢里的碎骨还粘在我爪上。
lines.en: Nest bone shards still cling to my claws.

lines.zh: 我数着步子，一、二、三、四。
lines.en: I count my steps: one, two, three, four.

lines.zh: 扭曲之地的草是苦的，我照啃。
lines.en: Grass in the twisted land is bitter; I chew anyway.

lines.zh: 三只跟着我，谁也不肯落后。
lines.en: Three follow me; none will fall behind.

lines.zh: 走过的土里留下细细的牙印。
lines.en: Thin tooth marks remain in the soil I cross.

lines.zh: 我拖着肚子，慢慢蹭过石头。
lines.en: I drag my belly slowly over the stones.

lines.zh: 巢塌了，我们换个地方继续啃。
lines.en: The nest collapsed; we go gnaw elsewhere.

lines.zh: 别挡道，我正赶着去咬东西。
lines.en: Do not block me; I am off to bite something.

lines.zh: 我磨着门牙，声音像砂纸。
lines.en: I grind my front teeth; it sounds like sandpaper.

lines.zh: 巢角还留着上一顿的壳。
lines.en: A shell from my last meal sits in the nest corner.

lines.zh: 四只挤在一起，谁也没睡着。
lines.en: Four of us huddle together, none asleep.

lines.zh: 诅咒在骨头里嗡嗡地响。
lines.en: The curse hums inside my bones.

lines.zh: 我咬住自己的尾巴，又松开。
lines.en: I bite my own tail, then let go.

lines.zh: 扭曲之地的风带着腐味。
lines.en: Wind from the twisted land brings a rotten smell.

lines.zh: 我把牙印留在巢口的木头上。
lines.en: I leave tooth marks on the wood at the nest mouth.

lines.zh: 肚子又叫了，可这里没东西啃。
lines.en: My belly growls again, but there is nothing to gnaw.

lines.zh: 我盯着巢壁，等它裂开缝。
lines.en: I stare at the nest wall, waiting for a crack.

lines.zh: 小的那只在啃我的后腿。
lines.en: The little one is chewing on my hind leg.

lines.zh: 我不叫，我只咬。
lines.en: I do not call out; I only bite.

lines.zh: 獠牙短，可一天要磨三次。
lines.en: My fangs are short, but I hone them thrice daily.

lines.zh: 巢底铺着我啃剩的骨渣。
lines.en: The nest floor is lined with bone bits I chewed.

lines.zh: 黑夜在巢外转，我们不出声。
lines.en: Night circles outside the nest; we make no sound.

lines.zh: 我又把巢壁啃薄了一层。
lines.en: I've gnawed the nest wall a layer thinner again.

lines.zh: 我把耳朵贴地，听外面的脚步。
lines.en: I press an ear to the floor and listen for footsteps outside.

lines.zh: 你站着，看起来像能啃的东西。
lines.en: You stand there looking like something I could gnaw.

lines.zh: 我歪头，把你从头到脚量一遍。
lines.en: I tilt my head and measure you top to bottom.

lines.zh: 你的靴子很硬，我先记下了。
lines.en: Your boots look hard; I have noted that.

lines.zh: 四双眼睛同时抬起来看你。
lines.en: Four pairs of eyes lift toward you at once.

lines.zh: 别把手伸来，我咬得比你想的快。
lines.en: Do not reach out; I bite faster than you think.

lines.zh: 我嗅了嗅，你不是巢里的味道。
lines.en: I sniff; you do not smell like the nest.

lines.zh: 你影子压过来，我退后半步。
lines.en: Your shadow reaches me; I step back half a pace.

lines.zh: 我在算你身上有几处能下口。
lines.en: I am counting the places on you I could bite.

lines.zh: 盯着我看，牙也不会变短。
lines.en: Stare at me all you like; my teeth will not shrink.

lines.zh: 你腰上挂的东西，闻着有点甜。
lines.en: What hangs at your waist smells faintly sweet.

lines.zh: 我看你，是因为你比石头软。
lines.en: I watch you because you are softer than stone.

lines.zh: 巢里的同伴也在看你，一起看。
lines.en: My nestmates watch you too, all together.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我眼睛就亮一点。
lines.en: Each step you retreat brightens my eyes.

lines.zh: 别转身，我讨厌追着背影跑。
lines.en: Do not turn away; I hate chasing a back.

lines.zh: 牙崩了一颗，我还剩很多。
lines.en: One tooth chipped; I have plenty left.

lines.zh: 打我？那你也得让我咬一口。
lines.en: Hit me? Then let me have one bite.

lines.zh: 血和诅咒一起流出来。
lines.en: Blood and curse run out together.

lines.zh: 我缩成壳一样的一团。
lines.en: I curl into a shell-like ball.

lines.zh: 疼得我牙都合不上了。
lines.en: It hurts so much my teeth will not close.

lines.zh: 你打断了我磨牙的声音。
lines.en: You interrupted the sound of my honing.

lines.zh: 巢里的同伴听见了，会来的。
lines.en: My nestmates heard that; they will come.

lines.zh: 这一下，我记在牙上了。
lines.en: I will keep this blow in my teeth.

lines.zh: 别以为矮就好打。
lines.en: Do not think short means easy to hit.

lines.zh: 我退两步，牙还朝你。
lines.en: I back off two steps, teeth still toward you.

lines.zh: 那味道，比石头香多了。
lines.en: That smell is far better than stone.

lines.zh: 你手里是什么？拿近点。
lines.en: What is in your hand? Bring it closer.

lines.zh: 我肚子空着，牙可没空。
lines.en: My belly is empty; my teeth are not idle.

lines.zh: 巢里四张嘴都在等这一口。
lines.en: Four mouths in the nest wait for this bite.

lines.zh: 只要一点碎屑，我就跟你走。
lines.en: Just a few crumbs and I will follow you.

lines.zh: 诅咒也在催我靠近那味道。
lines.en: The curse also urges me toward that smell.

lines.zh: 别晃，晃得我牙都痒了。
lines.en: Do not wave it; waving makes my teeth itch.

lines.zh: 我先闻，再咬，你站远点。
lines.en: I sniff first, then bite; stand farther back.

lines.zh: 扭曲之地长不出这种东西。
lines.en: The twisted land never grows anything like this.

lines.zh: 你手抖了，我会咬到手指。
lines.en: Your hand shakes; I might bite the fingers.

lines.zh: 撞我一下，等于踢马蜂窝。
lines.en: Bumping me is kicking a hornet nest.

lines.zh: 骨头撞骨头，谁都没退。
lines.en: Bone meets bone; neither of us gives way.

lines.zh: 你踩到我尾巴了，松脚。
lines.en: You stepped on my tail; move your foot.

lines.zh: 四只一起顶回去，你顶得住？
lines.en: Four of us shove back; can you hold?

lines.zh: 巢里学的规矩，谁撞谁挨咬。
lines.en: Nest rule: whoever bumps gets bitten.

lines.zh: 别用身体试我的牙口。
lines.en: Do not test my bite with your body.

lines.zh: 这一撞，把我刚磨的牙撞歪了。
lines.en: That bump knocked my fresh-honed tooth crooked.

lines.zh: 我矮，可我从下面咬上去。
lines.en: I am short, but I bite upward from below.

lines.zh: 你退开，我就不追这口气。
lines.en: Step away and I will let this grudge go.

lines.zh: 撞得我肚子都叫了一声。
lines.en: You bumped the growl right out of my belly.

lines.zh: 巢底铺好了骨渣，进来吧。
lines.en: The nest floor is lined with bone bits; come in.

lines.zh: 我替你把最软的那块留着了。
lines.en: I saved the softest patch for you.

lines.zh: 诅咒要传，牙也要传下去。
lines.en: The curse must pass on, and so must the teeth.

lines.zh: 一起咬同一根骨头，就算说定。
lines.en: We bite the same bone; that makes it settled.

lines.zh: 你别抢我磨牙的那块石头。
lines.en: Do not take the stone I hone my teeth on.

lines.zh: 四只里，我只让你进巢。
lines.en: Of the four, I let only you into the nest.

lines.zh: 巢口那圈牙印，是我留的记号。
lines.en: The tooth marks at the nest mouth are my sign.

lines.zh: 冬天来之前，得多啃些东西。
lines.en: Before winter we must gnaw a great deal more.

lines.zh: 靠近点，我今天不咬你。
lines.en: Come closer; I will not bite you today.

lines.zh: 巢里会多几张小嘴要喂。
lines.en: Soon the nest will hold more small mouths to feed.

lines.zh: 掉了块骨头？归我了。
lines.en: Dropped a bone? It is mine now.

lines.zh: 这碎屑我叼回巢里去。
lines.en: I will carry these crumbs back to the nest.

lines.zh: 你丢的，我咬一口再还你。
lines.en: You dropped it; let me bite it, then return it.

lines.zh: 轻的东西，牙一合就带走。
lines.en: Light things leave with one snap of my teeth.

lines.zh: 这石头能磨牙，我要了。
lines.en: This stone hones teeth; I am taking it.

lines.zh: 巢底正缺这么个边角料。
lines.en: The nest floor lacks exactly this scrap.

lines.zh: 别抢，我咬人比捡东西快。
lines.en: Do not grab it; I bite faster than I pick up.

lines.zh: 我叼着它，走起来摇摇晃晃。
lines.en: Carrying it, I wobble as I walk.

lines.zh: 有味道，能吃，带走。
lines.en: It smells, it is edible, it comes with me.

lines.zh: 四只分，我叼最大那块。
lines.en: Split four ways, I take the biggest piece.

lines.zh: 牙已经痒了，就你了。
lines.en: My teeth are itching already; you will do.

lines.zh: 四只同时转头，你被选中了。
lines.en: Four heads turn at once; you have been chosen.

lines.zh: 你身上那股味道，让诅咒醒了。
lines.en: That smell on you woke the curse.

lines.zh: 巢穴里的骨头，都是我们啃的。
lines.en: Every bone in this den was gnawed by us.

lines.zh: 你踩进巢的地界，得留点东西。
lines.en: You stepped into nest ground; leave something.

lines.zh: 先咬脚，再咬别的。
lines.en: First the ankle, then the rest.

lines.zh: 我看见你的靴子了，很结实。
lines.en: I have seen your boots; they look sturdy.

lines.zh: 别跑，跑起来骨头更香。
lines.en: Do not run; running makes bones smell better.

lines.zh: 影子太长，我顺着影子找你。
lines.en: Your shadow is long; I follow it to you.

lines.zh: 巢里那几只让开，这顿归我。
lines.en: The others step aside; this meal is mine.

lines.zh: 我慢慢靠近，牙可不慢。
lines.en: I approach slowly; my teeth do not.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，我连手一起咬。
lines.en: I want what is in your hand, fingers included.

lines.zh: 诅咒指了方向，我就扑。
lines.en: The curse points the way; I lunge.

lines.zh: 别以为矮就追不上你。
lines.en: Do not think being short means I cannot catch you.

lines.zh: 绕着你转，找一块软的地方。
lines.en: Circling you, looking for a soft spot.

lines.zh: 我的牙在找角度，别动。
lines.en: My teeth are finding an angle; hold still.

lines.zh: 你后退的每一步，我都记着。
lines.en: I remember every step you retreat.

lines.zh: 四只分好了位置，你只有两条腿。
lines.en: Four of us have our places; you have two legs.

lines.zh: 影子贴上来的时候，就该咬了。
lines.en: When the shadow touches you, it is time.

lines.zh: 我先咬脚跟，让你慢下来。
lines.en: I bite the heel first, to slow you down.

lines.zh: 我咬着石头过来，你别站定。
lines.en: I am coming, chewing stone; do not stand still.

lines.zh: 别往巢那边退，那边更挤。
lines.en: Do not back toward the nest; it is more crowded there.

lines.zh: 我低着身子，不是怕你。
lines.en: I keep low, and not from fear.

lines.zh: 你举着武器，那我就咬手。
lines.en: You raise a weapon; then I bite the hand.

lines.zh: 磨过的牙，咬下去只一下。
lines.en: Honed teeth need only one bite.

lines.zh: 巢里的骨渣，很快多你一份。
lines.en: Soon the nest bone pile will have your share.

lines.zh: 你退到墙边了，巢穴就在后面。
lines.en: You have backed to the wall; my burrow is right behind.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，眨眼我就到跟前。
lines.en: Do not blink; blink and I am at your feet.

lines.zh: 你踩到巢边的碎骨了。
lines.en: You stepped on the bone shards by the nest.

lines.zh: 咬住了，别想甩开。
lines.en: Bitten. Do not think you can shake me off.

lines.zh: 牙陷进布里，往下一撕。
lines.en: Teeth sink into cloth and rip downward.

lines.zh: 这一口，是替空肚子咬的。
lines.en: This bite is for my empty belly.

lines.zh: 你腿上会留个浅浅的洞。
lines.en: Your leg will keep a shallow hole.

lines.zh: 我咬完就退，巢里教的。
lines.en: I bite, then retreat; the nest taught me that.

lines.zh: 骨头在牙下响了一声。
lines.en: Bone sounded once beneath my teeth.

lines.zh: 别用脚踹，我会咬住鞋。
lines.en: Do not kick; I will bite the boot.

lines.zh: 四只轮着咬，你挡哪边？
lines.en: Four of us take turns; which side do you guard?

lines.zh: 味道比石头好，难怪诅咒馋。
lines.en: Better tasting than stone; no wonder the curse hungers.

lines.zh: 我松口了，血还在我牙上。
lines.en: I let go; your blood stays on my teeth.

lines.zh: 巢穴裂开，我第一个爬出来。
lines.en: The nest splits; I am the first to crawl out.

lines.zh: 诅咒把我从土里啃出来。
lines.en: The curse gnawed me out of the soil.

lines.zh: 四只一起，巢里就挤不下了。
lines.en: Four at once; the nest could not hold us.

lines.zh: 这地方的味道，像我的巢。
lines.en: This place smells like the nest I was born in.

lines.zh: 我先磨牙，再认路。
lines.en: First I hone my teeth, then learn the paths.

lines.zh: 扭曲之地放我出来找东西啃。
lines.en: The twisted land released me to find something to gnaw.

lines.zh: 土还粘在我背上，巢在下面。
lines.en: Soil clings to my back; the nest lies below.

lines.zh: 你们这儿没有骨头味，可惜。
lines.en: No bone smell here; a pity.

lines.zh: 我出来时踩碎了三个蛋壳。
lines.en: I crushed three eggshells on my way out.

lines.zh: 新生第一件事，找最近的牙印。
lines.en: My first act: find the nearest tooth marks.

lines.zh: 巢里那几只还在往外挤。
lines.en: The others are still squeezing out behind me.

lines.zh: 诅咒给了牙，路我自己找。
lines.en: The curse gave me teeth; I find my own way.

lines.zh: 这里太亮了，我得找个洞。
lines.en: Too bright here; I need to find a hole.

lines.zh: 别急着走，我还没咬过活物。
lines.en: Do not hurry off; I have never bitten anything living.

lines.zh: 毛烧焦的味道，我不喜欢。
lines.en: Singed fur smells; I do not like it.

lines.zh: 从高处掉下，肋骨响了一声。
lines.en: Dropped from a height; a rib clicked.

lines.zh: 水灌进嘴里，我咳出沙子。
lines.en: Water fills my mouth; I cough up sand.

lines.zh: 炸得我滚了两圈，牙还在。
lines.en: The blast rolls me twice; my teeth remain.

lines.zh: 箭扎在背上，像根刺。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my back like a thorn.

lines.zh: 法术的味道有点甜，牙不喜欢。
lines.en: The spell tastes sweet; my teeth do not approve.

lines.zh: 没东西啃，我啃自己的爪子。
lines.en: Nothing to gnaw; I chew my own claws.

lines.zh: 雷打我身上，毛全竖起来了。
lines.en: Lightning struck me; all my fur stands up.

lines.zh: 掉进虚空，牙还在空咬。
lines.en: Falling through the void, my teeth still snap at nothing.
